name: Sovereign landing zone
description: A foundational, multi-environment landing zone -- network, IAM, data, runtime and observability modules -- deployed through Terraform plan/apply/drift pipelines, with a region allowlist and a residency sweep that raises on an empty result, enforced before any resource is created. Grounded in P14 ("Sovereignty and residency"), P15 ("Infrastructure as code and runtime topology") and module M5.

parameters.name: allowed_regions
parameters.description: The region allowlist this landing zone's residency sweep enforces.

parameters.name: environments
parameters.description: The environment tiers this landing zone provisions (e.g. dev, staging, prod).

parameters.name: residency_sweep_on_apply
parameters.description: Whether a residency sweep runs and blocks apply on any out-of-region resource.

parameters.name: network_topology
parameters.description: The network topology composed across environments.

preconditions: A jurisdiction pack naming the allowed regions and residency rule has already been selected for the tenant (P14).
A Terraform module library exists for network, IAM, data, runtime and observability composition (P15).

outputs.description: Composed VPC/subnet/firewall topology for the declared environments.
Baseline IAM roles and Workload Identity bindings.
Cloud Build pipeline running Terraform plan, apply and drift detection.
Signed evidence that every provisioned resource is in an allowed region.

validation_rules.description: allowed_regions must be non-empty; a landing zone with no declared region allowlist cannot pass the residency sweep (P14: "residency sweep that raises on empty results").
residency_sweep_on_apply must be true in every PUBLISHED release; disabling the sweep is only permitted in a DRAFT release used for local testing.
network_topology=hub_spoke should only be chosen when environments has at least two entries; a single environment does not justify hub-spoke's shared-services overhead.

evidence: CLOUD-ARCHITECTURE-PATTERNS.md P14 ("`uk-landing-zone-accelerator`: UK-sovereign landing zone in a declared region; residency sweep that raises on empty results") and P15 ("a Terraform module library (landing zone, network, IAM, data, runtime, observability, guardrails) ... Cloud Build for plan/apply/drift").
